content.comment_body: I'm trying to connect to a [product_name] from my Android phone using OpenVPN, but the ovpn file isn't functioning as expected. The connection works with OpenVPN Gui on my PC when I upload the ovpn config, but I can't get it to work on OpenVPN for Android. On the PC, uploading the ovpn file works easily, but the process seems more complicated on Android. Does anyone have suggestions? Should I modify the ovpn config text, or is there a better alternative app than OpenVPN for Android? Appreciate any guidance.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces challenges connecting to a [product_name] communication module from an Android device with an OpenVPN config file that already works on Windows. The Android setup for importing and using the ovpn file appears more complex, causing confusion over app compatibility or whether config file changes are needed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an equally simple VPN setup process for both Windows and Android, hoping for direct compatibility with the existing ovpn file and a hassle-free connection on Android, preferably without needing to edit the file or use a different app.
